projects.name: Rockdale Facility
projects.quote: Our Rockdale Facility in Texas, with 700 MW of developed capacity, is among the largest digital infrastructure campuses in North America, as measured by developed capacity.

projects.name: Corsicana Facility
projects.quote: In 2024, we completed construction of 400 MW of developed capacity at our second large-scale Texas development, the Corsicana Facility.

projects.name: AMD Lease
projects.quote: Additionally, in January 2026, we announced the execution of the AMD Lease to provide 25 MW of critical IT load capacity at the Rockdale Facility.

projects.name: Rockdale Facility land acquisition
projects.quote: In January 2026, we announced the acquisition in fee simple of the approximately 200-acre parcel of land underlying the Rockdale Facility, which was previously occupied pursuant to a long-term ground lease.
